# SpatialOrdinalPatterns

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
A symbolic representation of spatially arranged data points based on their relative order rather than absolute values. Provides permutation-invariant, distributed descriptors for in-network analysis of neuromorphic sensor or node arrays.
